documentation.dec_04_item_3_verbatim: 3. **Audit:** Append every capability transition to a durable audit ledger with old/new state, app policy version, model, firmware, evidence ID, reason, actor, and timestamp. Protocol anomalies automatically transition the affected capability to `suspended`; they never auto-enable a capability. Audit and switch data are included in redacted diagnostics, backup/export, migration, and full deletion tests.
